relationships.subject: DREAM
relationships.evidence_quote: DREAM inhibits PDYN transcription while its genetic deletion results in upregulation of expression of this gene [54].

relationships.subject: Prodynorphin
relationships.evidence_quote: Dynorphins are endogenous KOR ligands [2,3] acting through mitogen-activated protein kinases [4].

key_findings: Review: human PDYN is regulated by neuron/glia-specific differential methylation (DMR1, DMR2) and transcription factors such as DREAM, CTCF, REST, NF-κB and YY1.
